subject: ClearQuill security intake: scheduling call and evidence sprint
messages:
From: Liam Carter <liam.carter@clearquill.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Carlos Vega <carlos.vega@clearquill.com>, security@clearquill.com
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG/CAIQ intake: request to schedule intake call and share evidence list

Hi Aisha —

Thanks for taking this. We're starting a security intake for ClearQuill as part of our upcoming procurement review. We'd like to schedule a 30-45 minute intake to walk through the CAIQ/SIG, confirm the artifact list, and agree on delivery windows.

Attached is our CAIQ question bank (filtered) and a small CSV listing the log samples we'd like to review. High level asks:
- Walkthrough of deployment topology and ingress/egress controls
- Confirmation of logging scope (system, application, access) and retention windows
- Clarify data residency and export controls for EU customers (we'll note any regional specifics during the call)

Our availability next week: 5/19 (afternoon ET) and 5/20 (morning ET). Do you have a preferred time? Also please send any instructions we need to follow for secure evidence drop (SFTP / shared drive / pre-signed links).

Thanks,
Liam Carter
Head of Security Operations
ClearQuill Analytics

Attachments: clearquill_caiq_questions.xlsx, logs-sample-list.csv

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam Carter <liam.carter@clearquill.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ intake: request to schedule intake call and share evidence list

Hi Liam — thanks for the details and the attachments. 5/20 morning ET works for our team. Proposed slot:

Thursday 2027-05-20, 10:00 AM ET / 07:00 AM PT — 45 minutes

Agenda (proposed):
1) 10m - Introductions + scope (CAIQ sections we're prioritizing)
2) 20m - Topology, auth, and logging coverage walk-through
3) 10m - Evidence handoff method & timeline (log samples, architecture diagram, encryption attestations)
4) 5m - Next steps + owners

For the evidence drop we prefer either a temporary S3 pre-signed link or our secure ShareFile intake (we'll provide details). For the call please include any engineering owners who can speak to logging and retention.

We typically ask for the following artifacts ahead of the intake (if possible):
- Network diagram (annotated with regions and VPC/subnet boundaries)
- Retention & deletion policy excerpts (logs, backups, backups of backups)
- Example audit/log samples (redacted) — CSV or compressed logs are fine
- PKI/certificate provisioning notes and key rotation schedule

I'll attach our short intake instructions PDF with S3 ShareFile steps.

Looking forward —
Aisha Rahman
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_evidence-drop-instructions.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 12:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: ClearQuill intake slot and commercial heads-up

Aisha / Priyom —

Thanks for lining this up. Quick commercial/ops notes:
- ClearQuill is in evaluation for a potential 3-region Dedicated deployment; they're squeezing the procurement timeline and may request an accelerated audit window.
- Keep the intake focused on CAIQ sections A1/A2 (network), F (logging), and E (data residency) — that's what procurement will flag.
- If they ask for a demo environment or temporary access for log export, let's route through engineering (Priyom) and limit to timeboxed SCP role.

Action items for the call:
- Priyom: be prepared to describe S3 pre-signed workflow and the minimum log retention we guarantee per tier.
- Aisha: confirm whether we can provide a 2-week dry-run for log exports (engineering permitting).
- Marissa: I'll follow up with procurement to flag the potential timeline and see if we need to prep a PSA for accelerated onboarding.

I'll be on the call as well to capture commercial blockers.

-Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Liam Carter <liam.carter@clearquill.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Carlos Vega <carlos.vega@clearquill.com>, security@clearquill.com
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 07:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ intake: request to schedule intake call and share evidence list

Aisha / team —

Thanks — 10:00 AM ET on 5/20 is confirmed for us. Carlos (cc'd) will be the engineering lead on the call. We'll aim to drop the requested artifacts to the shared Drive by 5/21 EOD, but we wanted to confirm your preferred path for the drop: S3 pre-signed links are fine for us.

Two quick clarifications ahead of the meeting:
- For log samples, we'll include 72-hour windows for app and auth logs (redacted PII). Is that sufficient for your initial review?
- For crypto/key rotation, our security team prefers an exported rotation schedule PDF rather than raw vault snapshots — is that acceptable?

Link to our intake notes for reference: https://clearquill.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/Security/pages/01234/Compliance+Intake

See you Thursday,
Liam
Head of Security Operations
ClearQuill Analytics

Attachments: logs-sample-list.csv

On Thu, 20 May 2027 at 16:45, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Thanks for confirming, Liam. 72-hour redacted windows are perfect for the intake. A PDF schedule for key rotation is also fine.
>
> We will send S3 pre-signed drop instructions to your security alias by EOD today and cc your engineering lead. Priyom will lead the data-transfer runbook portion of the call.
>
> Quick note for the meeting: we'll record minutes and capture owners in the hubspot record so procurement and CS can follow.
>
> — Aisha
> Senior Security & Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
